title: 1RB0LC_1RC1RA_1RD0RF_0LE---_1LA1LE_0RA1LD: PR 93's engine rechecked (does not apply), no halt to 10^12 direct, 1.9·10^13 accelerated; a fuse times the epochs
text: PR 93's collision rule fails on this table (the head runs right), so the engine does not carry over. Direct C: no halt in 10^12 steps; rsim_fast: none in 1.94·10^13. Inside an epoch, long passes eat a run of 1s 3 cells at a time; when it is gone the epoch ends.
